recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. If the usability improvement is still desired, implement or close HL7/kindling#115 first, then add supported Questionnaire source content after the tooling convention exists.
issue_request: FHIR-20620 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Questionnaire change request asking for publication tooling support so a resource Operations tab could point readers to externally defined SDC operations.
initial_application: No FHIR source commit mentioning FHIR-20620 was found. Current core source has Questionnaire active in source/fhir.ini, an empty source/questionnaire/list-Questionnaire-operations.xml, and existing Questionnaire narrative that points readers to the Structured Data Capture IG for guidance, extensions, and operations.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread and later Confluence minutes both treat the request as a publication tooling capability. The 2023 FHIR IG Authoring minutes approved the persuasive-with-modification outcome by adding HL7/kindling#115, whose open Approved enhancement requests operations-intro.xml and operations-notes.xml support.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. A source-only change in HL7/fhir would be speculative or inert because current tooling has no discovered operations-intro/operations-notes convention to consume external Operations-tab content.
